title: Religion, fads and heroin among musicians
summary: He knew little of religious movements and says few used heroin while most drank whiskey.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Did the bands become involved in any kind of religious movements during your time? Things like becoming Muslims and so forth? Do you know anything about that? Nobody was a Muslim?
Play the music right as they had or leave them alone.
Nobody was into any religious things?
Religious songs, that's all right.

No, I don't know too much about that.
You never heard anything about that?
No.
Were they involved in any kind of fads?
I don't know about that.
What about well-known musicians that may have been hung up on drugs like heroin?
I can't see it. No excuse for it.
No, but I'm saying, did you know any musicians like in the 30's and so forth that were addicted, or in the 20's?
Yes, I did.
Were there a lot of them? Was it a common practice?
No.
More people drank than used -
Sure did.
Than used heroin or something like that, but there were a few that did?
They needed their whiskey.
